description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
